title: Witness: SALN does not prove Sara Duterte’s ownership of GenCorp

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte’s “unilateral declaration” that she was a stockholder of GenCorp Industries Inc. does not make her one, its counsel told the Senate impeachment court on Wednesday. Testifying for the defense in the impeachment trial of the vice president, Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay maintained that Duterte had no stakes in the corporation. READ: Witness: Sara Duterte had no GenCorp stake, post from 2022 to 2025 Public prosecutor Lorna Kapunan though pointed out that the vice president herself declared in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth (Saln) that she was a stockholder of the company. “So […]...
